_doc: Test files the lifecycle guard reports as leaking at the 11a base. This list only shrinks: 11b adds each file's missing destroy()/dispose() teardown and removes the entry, and the guard fails a listed file that runs clean. The plan's row 10 counted 20 files with a throwaway probe that did not release a signal-owned listener when its signal aborted; Task 2 re-derives the list with the real guard, which does, so the measured floor is 14 files. Keys are paths relative to Client/. `reasons` names why a non-11a-base entry is listed.

reasons.tests/unit/voice-audio-tab.test.ts: Leaks one live window:owncord:pref-change listener (the Voice & Audio settings pane). Arrived on the dev base after 11a started (Linux voice 1b, https://github.com/J3vb/OwnCord/pull/1700), so it is not in the 11a base. 11b owns the fix.
reasons.src/features/voice/e2eeWorker.test.ts: Leaks one live window:owncord:pref-change listener (the E2EE worker's native-backend path). Arrived on the dev base after 11a started (Linux voice 1b, https://github.com/J3vb/OwnCord/pull/1700), so it is not in the 11a base. 11b owns the fix.
